sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect personal information that you provide directly to us when planning or reserving private desert tours, imperial city excursions, or tailor-made Moroccan expeditions.

This includes your full name, email address, telephone / WhatsApp number, country of residence, party size, travel dates, and itinerary customizations. When interacting with our website, standard technical diagnostics such as browser type, device category, and IP address are collected securely via encrypted server logs.
We never collect sensitive personal categories (such as racial background, political opinions, or religious beliefs) without explicit operational necessity or your prior written consent.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Your data is processed strictly in accordance with international data protection principles (GDPR) and Moroccan Law No. 09-08 promulgated by the CNDP (Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel).

Primary operational purposes include securing private transport permits, scheduling accredited Berber desert drivers, booking boutique riads, answering customer inquiries, and issuing official reservation vouchers.
We never sell, lease, or distribute your personal details to advertising networks or third-party data brokers.

sections.title: Comprehensive Cookie Policy
paragraphs: Cookies are compact text files stored on your computer or mobile device when you browse websites. They enable our platform to remember your navigation choices and ensure secure operation.

Under the EU ePrivacy Directive and GDPR Art. 6(1)(f), strictly necessary cookies are placed to deliver core security and navigation features. Optional analytics cookies are placed exclusively upon your freely given, informed, and revocable consent (Art. 6(1)(a)).

callout.title: Full Visitor Autonomy
callout.desc: You can modify or withdraw your cookie permissions at any time without impacting your ability to browse our tours or contact our team.

sections.title: Cookie Inventory & Categories
paragraphs: We maintain complete transparency regarding every tracking identifier and cookie stored on your browser. Review the active cookie matrix below for technical specifics, providers, and expiration durations.

sections.title: Data Security & Technical Safeguards
paragraphs: We implement rigorous administrative, physical, and digital safeguards to defend your personal information against accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, and disclosure.

All web traffic is encrypted end-to-end using modern TLS 1.3 cryptographic protocols with strict HTTPS enforcement. Strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) and code injection vulnerabilities.
Access to guest reservation details is strictly compartmentalized to authorized logistics coordinators managing your private Moroccan itinerary.

sections.title: Third-Party Service Processors
paragraphs: To deliver dependable travel planning, we collaborate with select infrastructure partners adhering to strict confidentiality and international privacy frameworks:

Hostinger Cloud Infrastructure for secure European VPS hosting; Google Workspace / Gmail SMTP for encrypted reservation confirmations; and Google Maps API for optional interactive location maps (initiated only upon visitor consent).

sections.title: Your Rights Under GDPR & Moroccan Law
paragraphs: Regardless of your location, you hold comprehensive rights regarding your personal records under GDPR and Moroccan Law No. 09-08:

Right of Access: Request a verified copy of your personal data. Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or outdated details. Right to Erasure: Request full deletion of your profile once contractual obligations conclude. Right to Restrict Processing & Data Portability: Limit processing or export records in standard formats.
